name: agent-usage
description: Monitor AI coding agent usage across AIHubMix, Amp, Antigravity, Claude, ClinePass, Codex, Copilot, Cursor, DeepSeek, Droid, Gemini, Grok, Kimi, MiniMax, MinimaxCN, OpenCode Go, Synthetic and z.ai
author: thuggyduck

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1

commands.name: agent-usage-menubar
commands.title: Agent Usage Menu Bar
commands.subtitle: Agent Usage
commands.description: Show agent usage in the menu bar

preferences.name: showAihubmix
preferences.title: Visible Agents
preferences.label: Show AIHubMix
preferences.description: Show AIHubMix balance in the list

preferences.name: aihubmixApiKey
preferences.title: AIHubMix Access Key (Optional)
preferences.description: Copy the Access Key from https://console.aihubmix.com/setting, or set AIHUBMIX_ACCESS_KEY in your shell.

preferences.name: showAmp
preferences.label: Show Amp
preferences.description: Show Amp usage in the list

preferences.name: showAntigravity
preferences.label: Show Antigravity
preferences.description: Show Antigravity usage in the list

preferences.name: showClaude
preferences.label: Show Claude
preferences.description: Show Claude usage in the list

preferences.name: showClinePass
preferences.label: Show ClinePass
preferences.description: Show ClinePass usage in the list

preferences.name: showCodex
preferences.label: Show Codex
preferences.description: Show Codex usage in the list

preferences.name: additionalCodexHomes
preferences.title: Additional Codex Homes (Optional)
preferences.description: Comma-separated CODEX_HOME directories to include in addition to the default Codex home

preferences.name: showCopilot
preferences.label: Show Copilot
preferences.description: Show Copilot usage in the list

preferences.name: copilotAuthToken
preferences.title: Legacy Copilot Token (Optional)
preferences.description: Existing single-account token. Add named accounts with Manage Accounts. Authentication is auto-detected from GitHub CLI first, then GH_TOKEN or GITHUB_TOKEN. Standard PATs may not work.

preferences.name: showCursor
preferences.label: Show Cursor
preferences.description: Show Cursor usage in the list

preferences.name: cursorCookieHeader
preferences.title: Cursor Cookie Header (Optional)
preferences.description: Optional fallback Cookie header from cursor.com. Usually auto-detected from your local Cursor.app login.

preferences.name: showDeepSeek
preferences.label: Show DeepSeek
preferences.description: Show DeepSeek balance in the list

preferences.name: deepseekApiKey
preferences.title: DeepSeek API Key (Optional)
preferences.description: Auto-detected from OpenCode login (deepseek) or DEEPSEEK_API_KEY/DEEPSEEK_KEY. Fallback: paste an API key from https://platform.deepseek.com/api_keys.

preferences.name: showDroid
preferences.label: Show Droid
preferences.description: Show Droid usage in the list

preferences.name: showGemini
preferences.label: Show Gemini
preferences.description: Show Gemini usage in the list

preferences.name: showGrok
preferences.label: Show Grok
preferences.description: Show Grok (xAI) usage in the list

preferences.name: showKimi
preferences.label: Show Kimi
preferences.description: Show Kimi usage in the list

preferences.name: kimiAuthToken
preferences.title: Kimi Authorization Token (Optional)
preferences.description: Auto-detected from OpenCode login (kimi-for-coding). Fallback: paste the Authorization header value from https://www.kimi.com/code/console DevTools. Format: 'Bearer eyJ...' or just 'eyJ...'

preferences.name: showMinimax
preferences.label: Show MiniMax
preferences.description: Show MiniMax usage in the list

preferences.name: minimaxApiToken
preferences.title: MiniMax API Token (Optional)
preferences.description: Optional fallback token. Usually auto-detected from MINIMAX_API_KEY environment variable (set in ~/.zshrc, ~/.bashrc, etc.).

preferences.name: showMinimaxCN
preferences.label: Show MinimaxCN
preferences.description: Show MinimaxCN (MiniMax 国内版) usage in the list

preferences.name: minimaxcnApiToken
preferences.title: MinimaxCN API Token (Optional)
preferences.description: Optional fallback token. Usually auto-detected from MINIMAX_CN_API_KEY environment variable (set in ~/.zshrc, ~/.bashrc, etc.).

preferences.name: showOpencodeGo
preferences.label: Show OpenCode Go
preferences.description: Show OpenCode Go subscription usage in the list

preferences.name: opencodegoWorkspaceId
preferences.title: OpenCode Go Workspace ID
preferences.description: Your OpenCode workspace ID (e.g. wrk_abc123 or just the suffix after wrk_). Found in the OpenCode dashboard URL.

preferences.name: opencodegoAuthCookie
preferences.title: OpenCode Go Auth Cookie
preferences.description: The 'auth' cookie value from your OpenCode session. Open opencode.ai, log in, then copy the 'auth' cookie from DevTools (Application → Cookies).

preferences.name: showSynthetic
preferences.label: Show Synthetic
preferences.description: Show Synthetic usage in the list

preferences.name: syntheticApiToken
preferences.title: Synthetic API Token (Optional)
preferences.description: Auto-detected from OpenCode login (synthetic). Fallback: paste your Synthetic API key from https://synthetic.new/billing.

preferences.name: showZai
preferences.label: Show z.ai (GLM)
preferences.description: Show z.ai (GLM) usage in the list

preferences.name: zaiApiToken
preferences.title: z.ai API Token (Optional)
preferences.description: Optional fallback token. Usually auto-detected from ZAI_API_KEY or GLM_API_KEY environment variable (set in ~/.zshrc, ~/.bashrc, etc.).

preferences.name: cacheTtl
preferences.title: Cache Duration (Seconds)
preferences.description: Cache duration in seconds for remote API requests. Set to 0 to disable caching.
